summary: Product manager with 5 years leading cross-functional teams from discovery to launch. Skilled at translating customer research into roadmaps that balance user needs with business goals.

Launched a mobile checkout redesign that increased conversion by 12% across iOS and Android.
Built and maintained the product analytics dashboard used in weekly leadership reviews.
Coordinated three quarterly release cycles across 4 engineering squads.
